notes.note: Reviewed ADR 0015 — Desktop-owned Command Station sidecar without service attachment against the bounded changed-source diff and its relevant lifecycle/stream/authority statements. The Rust delta adds only an iOS process-termination reload and a background assertion on existing finite-request deadline guards, with two iOS-only direct dependency declarations; credential, route, pairing, sidecar, release/provider and notification authority contracts in this document are unchanged. No prose update is needed for those claims. Existing physical-device and provider NOT_VERIFIED limits remain in force.

Reviewed the historical SSE decision and current reading note against fetchSSE. Resume jitter only schedules an existing transient wait; it preserves Last-Event-ID, replay ownership and per-viewer stream boundaries. No multiplexing, saturated-pool latency or live delivery qualification is added.

Reviewed the MobileDeviceHost, transport/diagnostic and native notification ownership claims against this bounded diff. iOS reload/grace, Android renderer recreation and metering do not move credential authority or request dispatch into the renderer; SDK jitter preserves cursor and authorization. Existing module boundaries and device-proof limits remain accurate; current scheduling details live in the mobile and SDK guides.

Reviewed held-follow-up foreground polling against useConversationInbox: explicit constrained-network signals lengthen the cadence from 2 to 10 seconds while unavailable/error states, authority fences and manual refresh/removal are unchanged. The design describes foreground polling without promising a fixed interval, so its current claims remain accurate.
